name: Des Moines Parts Distribution Center - Grimes IA

fieldNotes.location: Address 1000 SE 19th Street, Grimes IA — DTNA's Iowa / Des Moines Parts Distribution Center, the 9th PDC in DTNA's network, serving 200+ Midwest/Great Plains dealers; 50 employees, two shifts, up to 8 truckloads/day; footprint doubled in a 2024 expansion. Confirmed via DTNA press release and Grimes/Greater Des Moines business directories. Roster geocode moved 1,901 m; the corrected pin landed on the correct building. Center locked at 41.671050, -93.783700.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No perimeter fence, no barrier arm or gate, no guarded checkpoint at any road connection. Street View (2022-10) shows open grass frontage and uncontrolled driveways. Standard open spec-park layout.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No booth structure at any driveway or in the truck court.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: All dock doors on the east long face (single dock bank). Continuous door rhythm with trailers backed in; estimate ~30 doors, 25-50 band — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: East truck court holds trailers backed into docks plus a parking row of drop trailers; ~25-50 band, dropYard true.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Roughly 28 trailers counted in the east truck court (backed-in plus parking row).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: FALSE. Docks are a single bank on the east face only.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Wide, deep east truck court easily stages 3+ trucks before the docks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide, fully paved truck court with unused apron width — room for an express bypass lane.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Two open driveway connections to the road (one near the north car-park area, one toward the south end of the truck court) act as separate in/out routes.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Borderline. The PDC sits at the development edge of Grimes (a fast-growing Des Moines suburb) with farmland on the immediate west/south, but surrounded by an industrial park, big-box retail and dense residential subdivisions; classified Urban for the metro-Des-Moines suburban-industrial setting — flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.connectivityIssue: FALSE. Within a developed metro-Des-Moines industrial/retail area, not isolated; cellular coverage expected to be normal.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property.
